points.why: Signs all four links correctly, counts two negatives as reinforcing, and says the response feeds the cause rather than correcting it.
Identifies the balancing loop through more labeled data raising accuracy, and says which loop wins depends on load versus labeler capacity.
States the reinforcing loop can run either way, vicious under high load and virtuous when load is low.
Recommends capping work at labeler capacity, active learning for better-chosen examples, and tracking label quality against a gold set.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly rejects the idea that responding to each drop makes the loop self-correcting.
